purpose: Teach: 入園/ミニマム/コンソーシアム/原本/諸般/目途/休刊/乗り出す

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員のお子様の入園祝い制度を整えろ
lines.en: Set up a childcare enrollment gift program for our employees' children.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive. Authority without theatrics. Each clause lands with quiet weight. Exhale slightly on the period.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経費はミニマムに抑えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll keep costs to the bare minimum.
lines.style: Respectful acceptance with undertone of efficiency. Quick, assured. No hesitation—he's already thinking through the constraint.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界コンソーシアムに参加しろ
lines.en: And have us join the industry consortium.
lines.style: Same measured cadence as before. Direct instruction, no elaboration needed. Slight pause after the verb—the weight of the decision sitting there.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。契約書の原本を厳格に管理します
lines.en: Understood. I'll manage the contract originals with strict protocols.
lines.style: Steady, confirming. Each task item checked off mentally as he speaks. Professional precision without rushing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 諸般の事情を考慮しろ
lines.en: Factor in all the circumstances at play.
lines.style: Quieter this time—less instruction, more observation. Slight lean forward. He's giving Kenji room to think, not just execute.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新事業の目途は年度末です
lines.en: Understood. The new business initiative will be ready by year-end.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Kenji is already ahead—he knows what this means. No doubt in his voice, just quiet competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合誌の休刊情報も追え
lines.en: Track the closure announcements from competitors too.
lines.style: Minimal. Almost casual—but it's the kind of casual that only comes with experience. He's thinking two moves ahead.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新市場に乗り出す準備を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll have everything in place to enter the new markets.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Kenji matches Hiroshi's economy of language. Small breath at the end—the conversation is settling. He's got it.
